deployments_detail.use: Internal office-productivity AI assistants for employees, supporting document work, presentations, spreadsheets and meeting organization to save time on routine tasks. Described by PGE as in development/piloting. [none]

BIMS (Blade Inspection Management System): AI automatically detects and classifies wind turbine blade damage (coating damage, cracks, scratches, chips, holes, lightning-strike damage, dirt, prior-repair traces) from drone inspection photos, so technicians can prioritize repairs. Deployed by PGE Systemy and used operationally by PGE Energia Odnawialna across 349 turbines (1,047 blades), analyzing 100,000+ photos per annual inspection cycle. Platform rolled out end of 2023. [PGE Systemy (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 349 turbines / 1,047 blades / 100,000+ inspection photos analyzed per year

deployments_detail.use: SENSUM EcoDriving: machine-learning-based eco-driving support system for rail transport (PGE Energetyka Kolejowa). A central 'brain' collects and interprets telemetry from train journeys and on-board cab tablets give drivers real-time guidance (e.g. 'decelerate to 20 km/h') to smooth driving, hit punctual arrivals and cut traction energy consumption; ML continuously optimizes from recorded journeys. Tested over ~150 journeys with 19 drivers (Koleje Mazowieckie, Lodzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna), production launch scheduled mid-2024. [PGE Energetyka Kolejowa / PGE Systemy]
deployments_detail.value: 500,000+ system records processed in testing; ~150 test journeys

deployments_detail.use: Machine-learning models forecasting energy production and consumption by prosumers (customers who both consume and generate electricity), deployed at the PGE Obrot (retail supply) division to improve balancing and planning. [none]
